specialAbilities.name: Pack Tactics
specialAbilities.description: The wolf has Advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of its allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally doesn't have the Incapacitated condition.

specialAbilities.name: Shadow Stride
specialAbilities.description: In dim light or darkness the wolf has Advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks and moves without a sound.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) Piercing damage plus 3 (1d6) Necrotic damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it has the Prone condition.
